negative_findings.description: Every plain HTTP fetch of bank.gov.ua during this run returned HTTP 403 Forbidden — HTML pages (/ua/statistic/supervision-statist) and the OpenData API (/NBUStatService/v1/statdirectory/basindbank?json) alike.
negative_findings.result_summary: 0 successful fetches of bank.gov.ua; content confirmed to exist only via search-engine indexing (including 2026-dated items).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must assume browser-like headers or a headless browser for the NBU domain, and should prefer the data.gov.ua mirrors where equivalent datasets exist. This is a bot-defence hypothesis, NOT evidence the pages are dead.

negative_findings.description: No canonical URL was recovered for a per-bank statutory financial-statements landing page (individual licensed banks' IFRS statements republished by the NBU). Searches returned only aggregate/grouped datasets and the reporting-rules announcement.
negative_findings.result_summary: Aggregate data located; per-institution statement index not located in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Per-bank statements are the highest-value A1 artefact. It may sit behind the Unified Financial Reporting System (Єдина СФЗ) portal rather than on bank.gov.ua, which would move part of this cell outside the NBU domain.

negative_findings.description: The dedicated NBU webpage aggregating ownership-structure disclosures by non-bank financial institutions is announced in a news item, but its canonical hub URL could not be extracted because the news page could not be fetched.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ownership/beneficial-owner data for payment institutions is a key A1 attribute for the payments half of the run scope.

negative_findings.description: A search result pointed to https://new.bank.gov.ua/ua/statistic/supervision-statist, but the hostname failed DNS resolution (ENOTFOUND).
negative_findings.result_summary: new.bank.gov.ua does not resolve; likely a staging host that was indexed and later retired, or is internal-only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection configs must not be pointed at new.bank.gov.ua; use bank.gov.ua. Worth re-checking later in case NBU migrates to a redesigned site on that host.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed for the NBU press service was identified during this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Press releases appear reachable only via the /ua/news/all and /en/news/all listing pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a feed, press-release monitoring requires HTML crawling of a bot-defended host, raising collection cost and fragility.

coverage_gaps.description: Per-institution statutory financial statements (individual licensed banks' IFRS reports) were not located as a browsable NBU index; only aggregated/grouped data was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Investigate the Ukrainian Unified Financial Reporting System (Єдина система фінансової звітності / СФЗ, NSSMC-and-Ministry-of-Finance operated) as the likely host of per-entity taxonomy-tagged bank statements, and check individual bank IR pages as the fallback.

coverage_gaps.description: All NBU endpoints in this slice are unverified for automated liveness because the host returned 403 to the tooling used.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic verification pass with a realistic User-Agent and, if needed, a headless browser; classify 403s as bot-defended-live rather than dead.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-market statistical series from the NBU (card transaction volumes, POS/ATM terminal counts, cashless payment share) were not pinned to specific dataset URLs in this slice; only the payments registers and oversight pages were captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted follow-up on uk terms: 'Показники розвитку безготівкових розрахунків', 'Платіжні картки та платіжна інфраструктура', 'Оверсайт платіжних систем звіт', plus the corresponding NBUStatService endpoints.

coverage_gaps.description: English mirrors were confirmed to exist for the main NBU sections (/en/statistic, /en/stability/report, /en/news/all) but were not systematically enumerated per source.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Record both /ua/ and /en/ variants for every NBU source; the en edition of the Financial Stability Report and Banking Sector Review often lags the uk edition by days.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival strategy identified for NBU PDFs whose URLs carry mutable ?v= cache-busting suffixes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Mirror NBU PDFs locally on publication and record the canonical filename pattern (e.g. Banking_Sector_Review_YYYY-MM.pdf, FSR_YYYY-Hn_eng.pdf) rather than the versioned URL; consider Wayback Machine as a secondary archive.

brief: The National Bank of Ukraine is a single, unusually dense A1 node: it operates the State Register of Banks directory, the supervisory-statistics section, a documented OpenData REST API (NBUStatService, plus NBU_BankInfo for the bank directory), the semi-annual Financial Stability Report, the quarterly Banking Sector Review with a fully predictable PDF filename pattern, and an active press service that publishes sector profit aggregates ahead of the media cycle. Because the NBU is also Ukraine's payments regulator, the same domain carries the payment-infrastructure register, licensing of payment service providers and technological operators, and FMI oversight categorisations — covering both halves of the sector scope. The practical constraint is access, not availability: every plain fetch of bank.gov.ua returned HTTP 403 in this run, so collection should use browser-like headers or a headless browser and lean on the data.gov.ua CKAN mirrors of NBU datasets, which are unobstructed. The main substantive gap is per-institution statutory financial statements, which appear to be migrating into Ukraine's unified Financial Reporting System (Єдина СФЗ) taxonomy rather than living as a browsable NBU index.
